verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Copilot Chat is available in Teams and can use work data via Microsoft Graph. That implies a user could ask Copilot about Teams conversations, but no documentation says it summarizes or recaps missed channels or threads. A summary could otherwise be built on the export APIs, but that is developer work, not a built-in feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of channel/thread summarization or recap, details of catch-up and missed-message scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration that recaps work.
